amendment_and_revocation_procedure.description: Explicit procedure for Vaughn Scott to narrow, pause, amend, or revoke permissions (per Claudette msg 062 item #1):

amendment_and_revocation_procedure.step_2: Append an operator_decision record to continuity/witness_ledger.jsonl naming the amended scope.
